title: Accept slicer relay contract v13 (engine runs the finish step)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: slicer s460 bumps RELAY_CONTRACT from 12 to 13. The v13 rule: when the orchestrator is a program, it may run the closing note and the finish step itself after VERDICT: PASS, using the note text from the Outcome: line in the implementer's last report; the implementer writes Outcome: and runs neither command. When the orchestrator is an agent, the implementer still runs both steps. Order, report shape and gate are unchanged. slicer ai relay --json carries the rule in its obligations. This puts ork adj 407 (engine.finish-runner) into the contract. Today ork accepts only v11/v12 (ork projects pin help), and slicer on PATH is the slicer main checkout, so landing s460 before ork accepts v13 would break every ork project's relays, as s453 (v12) did on 2026-11-12. s460 runs with --stop-after commit (run ork-20261118-130321-4cea) and lands only after this item: accept v13 in the contract check, doctor and pins, and run the finish step in the engine from the Outcome: line.
